history.summary: A 570 sqft 1BR at $868k / $1,523 PSF in a large 1,327-unit OCR executive-condo-scale mass project at Choa Chu Kang, served only by the Teck Whye LRT (520m), not heavy rail. Decent rental footprint and big-development liquidity, but D23 1BR appreciation is pedestrian and the $1,523 PSF is already full for the location.
history.rating_rationale: Sol Acres (TOP 2019, 99LH, ~1,327 units) is a large, liquid development which supports the high score_1000 of 682 and gives a deep resale/rental pool. But the dossier carries no URA appreciation/txn data, the unit is LRT-fed (no MRT), and D23 Choa Chu Kang is a baseline OCR growth area (~3.7%/yr) with no near-term catalyst within 500m. $1,523 PSF for a small 1BR in Teck Whye is at the upper end of fair, leaving limited margin. Low entry price keeps it accessible but the investment case is average, not compelling.
red_flags: Only LRT access (Teck Whye 520m), no heavy-rail MRT
No URA appreciation/transaction data in dossier to confirm trajectory
1BR is the niche, narrowest tenant/buyer segment
$1,523 PSF is full for Choa Chu Kang location
catalysts: Large 1,327-unit development gives strong rental and resale liquidity
Low absolute quantum ($868k) widens buyer pool and keeps ABSD/entry friction low
Established Choa Chu Kang amenities and bus connectivity
